blocks.text: You can resolve, snooze, unsnooze, or reset the alerts as required.

DSPM generates alerts for any policy violations or misconfigurations that are detected in your cloud resources. You might want to manually resolve alerts that are not critical or do not pose any issues.

blocks.item: To resolve an alert, you must be assigned either an administrator role or a custom role with the Resolve Alerts permission. If you have the Resolve Alerts permission, you are automatically assigned permissions to reset manually resolved alerts.

When you manually resolve an alert, the alert is resolved only in the Zscaler Admin Console and the policy violation persists in the cloud service provider (CSP). The alert remains in the resolved state until you reset it.

blocks.text: To resolve a single alert or multiple alerts:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Alerts.
Select the All Alerts tab, and resolve the alert on the Alerts page or an individual alert's details page:
Alerts Page
Locate the required alert, click the Actions () icon, then select Resolve.
See image.
To resolve multiple alerts, select the corresponding checkboxes. From the Actions drop-down menu, select Resolve.
See image.
Individual Alert Page
Click the Alert ID to view that individual alert's page. From the Actions drop-down menu, select Resolve.
You can also access the Alerts page and an individual alert's page on the Grouped by Policy tab, Grouped by Resource tab, Dashboard, and the Resource Inventory page.
In the Resolve Alert window, enter the reason for resolving the alert.
Click Resolve.
See image.
A message appears indicating that the alerts are successfully resolved.

blocks.text: When you do not want to take any action for an alert at the moment, or you do not want to be notified for an alert, you can manually snooze the alert and specify the duration. When you snooze an alert, the alert notifications are paused and not shared with the recipients or third-party integrations within the specified snooze period.

blocks.item: To snooze an alert, you must be assigned either an administrator role or a custom role with the Snooze Alerts permission. If you have the Snooze Alerts permission, you are automatically assigned permissions to reset snoozed alerts.
A snoozed alert remains snoozed for the specified duration if the issue is resolved in the CSP or if the resource or policy is deleted.

blocks.text: To snooze a single alert or multiple alerts:

blocks.item: Go to Data Security > DSPM > Alerts.
Select the All Alerts tab, and snooze the alert on the Alerts page or an individual alert's page:
Alerts Page
Locate the required alert, click the Actions () icon, then select Snooze.
See image.
To snooze multiple alerts, select the corresponding checkboxes. From the Actions drop-down menu, select Snooze.
See image.
Individual Alert Page
Click the Alert ID to view that individual alert's page. From the Actions drop-down menu, select Snooze.
You can also access the Alerts page and an individual alert's page on the Grouped by Policy tab, Grouped by Resource tab, Dashboard, and the Resource Inventory page.
In the Snooze Alert window:
Reason for Snooze: Enter the reason for snoozing the alert.
Snooze End Date: Select the duration until when you want to snooze the alert.
By default, the alert is snoozed for 1 day.
Click Snooze.
See image.
A message appears indicating that the alerts are snoozed.

blocks.text: If you've accidentally snoozed an alert, or you want to start receiving notifications for a snoozed alert, you can unsnooze it. When you unsnooze an alert, the status of the alert is updated based on the latest policy findings.
To unsnooze a single alert or multiple alerts:

blocks.item: Go to Data Security > DSPM > Alerts.
Select the All Alerts tab, and unsnooze the alert on the Alerts page or the individual alert's page:
Alerts Page
Locate the required snoozed alert, click the Actions () icon, then select Unsnooze.
See image.
To unsnooze multiple snoozed alerts, select the corresponding checkboxes. From the Actions drop-down menu, select Unsnooze.
See image.
Individual Alert Page
Click the Alert ID of the snoozed alert to view that individual alert's page. From the Actions drop-down menu, select Unsnooze.
In the Unsnooze Alert window, click Unsnooze.
See image.
A message appears indicating that the alerts are unsnoozed.

blocks.text: If you've accidentally resolved an alert, you can reset the alert. When you reset an alert, the status of the alert is updated based on the latest policy findings.
To reset a single alert or multiple alerts:

blocks.item: Go to Data Security > DSPM > Alerts.
Select the All Alerts tab, and reset the alert on the Alerts page or an individual alert's page:
Alerts Page
Locate the required resolved alert, click the Actions () icon, then select Reset.
See image.
To reset multiple resolved alerts, select the corresponding checkboxes. From the Actions drop-down menu, select Reset.
See image.
Individual Alert Page
Click the Alert ID of the resolved alert to view that individual alert's page. From the Actions drop-down menu, select Reset.
In the Reset Alert window, click Reset.
See image.
A message appears indicating that the alerts are reset based on the latest policy findings.
